tools.name: add_todo
tools.description: Create a todo. Goes to the inbox unless when/list places it elsewhere.

tags.description: Tag names; each must already exist in Things unless create_tags is set

when.description: Schedule: today, tomorrow, evening, anytime, someday, yyyy-mm-dd, or natural language like 'next week'

list.description: Project name to file under (projects only)

tools.name: search_todos
tools.description: Find todos whose title or notes contain a substring. Matching is case-sensitive and literal. Covers open todos only.

tools.name: list_metadata
tools.description: List all projects, areas, or tags with their IDs.
